purpose: Public metadata-only source-feasibility audit; no code, README bodies, outcomes or tests.

eligibility_definition.unit: One distinct upstream software project/task with original persistent application state or an externally driven long-lived protocol. Repository identity does not prove statistical independence; shared subsystems remain possible.
positive_requires: State/reset rationale supported by public documentation or implementation structure
Both released source archives inspected and SHA256-verified
Pinned reference artifact present in metadata
A bounded local isolation design is identifiable without external paid services
not_counted: Aliases, flags, seeds, prompts, bots or language variants as separate families
Pure transformation/batch output without established domain-state transitions
Conditional UI/protocol surfaces promoted merely to reach 30

coverage.coverage_identity: 2 pilot + 50 original heldout + 148 extension = 200; 43 original + 24 extension = 67 distinct heldout source pairs

download_accounting.accounting: Retrieved response/archive payload bytes, excluding HTTP/TLS framing; no reference binary downloads. No further downloads after parent stop instruction.

conclusion.bounded_negative: The bounded extension establishes 8 additional source-evidenced candidates, bringing the preserved held-out pool to 19. It does not establish 30 qualified independent families. Conditional and uninspected possibilities remain, so it does not prove corpus-wide impossibility.
conclusion.remaining_scope: 13 inspected conditional tasks, 4 metadata state possibilities with deferred artifacts, 8 metadata protocol possibilities, and 8 unknowns need separate eligibility decisions. 107 tasks were not selected (3 source-screen exclusions plus 104 metadata-only screening exclusions). No further fetch or execution is authorized by this artifact.
conclusion.research_implication: Data-feasibility inventory only. No new algorithm hypothesis, superiority, SOTA progress, or automatic evaluation is implied.

preserved_prior_candidates.state_rationale: Config, ordered sheet paths, writable sheet copies and sheet catalog persist across creation/edit/search/list operations.
Application default handlers persist in XDG mimeapps.list and handlr config.
Allow/deny records and directory-specific environment authorization persist across exports and revocation.
Named host profiles and enabled/disabled entries persist across add/remove/toggle/list calls.
Imported appointments, recurring events, todos and note attachments persist in the calendar data directory.
An activity log stores running/completed time-tracking records and determines later lists/reports.
Incremental build logs/dependency state persist and control whether later invocations rerun commands.
Script aliases, commands and metadata persist in a TOML catalog across add/remove/list/run calls.
Vault registry, selected vault/folder, notes and folder history persist across commands.
Patch stack metadata and Git commit/ref state persist across new/push/pop/refresh/delete operations.
Notebook initialization/config, templates and created notes persist and affect later notebook commands.
